verdict.rationale: Datadog's Log Management and APM/tracing docs support tag-based faceting and search on arbitrary fields (e.g. user id, request id) without predefined indexes, and community evidence confirms ad-hoc field-to-dimension search is a favorite feature. However, there is no explicit documentation confirming true schema-less high-cardinality grouping at scale (vs facet limits, indexing costs) or benchmarks proving no pre-aggregation is needed. missing for 10: explicit docs on high-cardinality tag/facet limits and cost model, independent benchmarks confirming no indexing/pre-aggregation needed for arbitrary high-cardinality fields.
